# ISecuritizeArkEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/events/arks/ISecuritizeArkEvents.sol)


## Events
### SharesSentForRedemption
Emitted by `requestWithdrawal` after DSToken shares are sent to the Securitize
custodian for off-chain redemption.


```solidity
event SharesSentForRedemption(uint256 shares, uint256 expectedAssets);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|Shares transferred to the custodian wallet|
|`expectedAssets`|`uint256`|Underlying asset amount the keeper requested (informational)|

### CustodianWalletUpdated
Emitted when the Securitize custodian wallet is rotated.


```solidity
event CustodianWalletUpdated(address oldWallet, address newWallet);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`oldWallet`|`address`|The previous custodian wallet|
|`newWallet`|`address`|The new custodian wallet|

### ArkIsFrozenUpdated
Emitted whenever `setArkFrozen` is called.


```solidity
event ArkIsFrozenUpdated(bool isFrozen, uint256 frozenTotalAssets);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`isFrozen`|`bool`|The new frozen state|
|`frozenTotalAssets`|`uint256`|The total-assets snapshot reported while frozen|

### SweepSlippageUpdated
Emitted by `setSweepSlippage` after the cap is updated.


```solidity
event SweepSlippageUpdated(Percentage oldSweepSlippage, Percentage newSweepSlippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`oldSweepSlippage`|`Percentage`|The previous sweep slippage|
|`newSweepSlippage`|`Percentage`|The new sweep slippage|

### DepositSlippageUpdated
Emitted by `setDepositSlippage` after the cap is updated.


### SubscriptionFeeToleranceUpdated
Emitted by `setSubscriptionFeeTolerance` after the on-ramp fee tolerance is updated.


```solidity
event SubscriptionFeeToleranceUpdated(Percentage oldTolerance, Percentage newTolerance);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`oldTolerance`|`Percentage`|The previous subscription-fee tolerance|
|`newTolerance`|`Percentage`|The new subscription-fee tolerance|

### SubscribedViaOnRamp
Emitted when `_board` subscribes by relaying a Securitize-signed
`executePreApprovedTransaction` through the on-ramp.


```solidity
event SubscribedViaOnRamp(uint256 assets, uint256 sharesReceived);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|Base-asset amount subscribed|
|`sharesReceived`|`uint256`|DSTokens minted to the Ark in the same transaction|
